purpose: Freeze the sole Campaign146 return-amount cross-spectral phase-lead definition, accepted source, complete comparison boundary, ordered no-return gates, one development trial, execution assumptions and stop rules before opening any Campaign146 value.

candidate.name: intraday_return_amount_cross_spectral_phase_lead_59f
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Positive signed return discovery whose multiscale phase follows transaction-amount innovation within each half-session may identify information-led activity with three-session continuation.

exact_formula.return_vector: Within each half only, r_t=ln(close_{t+1}/close_t) for t=0..118; require all 120 closes finite and strictly positive.
exact_formula.amount_vector: Pair each return with its finite nonnegative destination amount and set x_t=ln(1+amount_{t+1}) for t=0..118.
exact_formula.demeaning: Subtract the separate within-half arithmetic mean from each length-119 return and log1p-amount vector.
exact_formula.dft: For each demeaned vector z, use the unnormalized length-119 DFT Z_k=sum_{t=0}^{118} z_t*exp(-2*pi*i*k*t/119) and retain every positive frequency k=1..59 exactly once.
exact_formula.oriented_half_phase: N_h=-sum_{k=1}^{59} Im(conj(X_k)*R_k), D_h=sum_{k=1}^{59} abs(X_k)*abs(R_k), and P_h=N_h/D_h; require finite D_h>0 and finite P_h in [-1,1]. The leading minus sign fixes positive score to amount-leading-return phase under the stated DFT convention.
exact_formula.support: Both halves must satisfy every close, amount, spectral-denominator and finite-range condition. Exact zero return and exact zero amount are retained before demeaning; a constant return or log1p-amount half makes its denominator zero and the stock-day missing.

comparison_contract.direction_normalization: use every comparator's frozen score direction

ordered_no_return_gates.name: binding_source_snapshot_formula_and_implementation_verification
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Before source values, bind this protocol, pure formula, tests, raw source, joint-clean identity, builder, verifier, ordered audit and output paths. After publication verify every partition byte/frame hash, exact projection/grid/formula/support/range/count and aggregate dataset digest.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: structural_coverage_variation_and_capacity_before_comparator_values
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: On the immutable quality/current-listing base require median daily coverage >=0.95, P05 daily coverage >=0.90, P05 eligible names >=50, at least 200 non-overlapping three-signal-session cohorts, at least five observed years, finite values in [-1,1], and at least 200 nonconstant cross-sectional sessions. Failure stops before comparator values, daily prices or forward returns.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: all_141_numeric_uniqueness_after_coverage_only
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Compare in exact v194 numeric order with all 141 eligible numeric comparators. Each comparison requires at least 50 paired names per session and at least 100 qualifying sessions. Every absolute median daily average-tie Spearman rank correlation must be strictly below 0.8; insufficient overlap fails closed and no comparator may be removed.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.purge: Purge three signal sessions at every train/validation boundary; t+1 entry and t+3 exit must remain in the same partition.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.execution: Reuse the frozen one-factor next-open to third-close Top-3 engine, CNY 200000 board-lot pilot, quality/listing gates, amount-participation checks, 0/5/10/20bp stress grid and survivor gates without override.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025: Open once for the whole campaign only if the sole trial survives every 2019-2023 development gate and a nonzero survivor record freezes the entire campaign; label it historically exposed quasi-out-of-sample. Otherwise leave it closed and unread.
